name: DL3DV-140 transfer audit (E13)

population.method: nerfacto, trained and evaluated locally (ns-train defaults, machine.seed 0, downscale 4 / 960P)

contract: see dl3dv_contract_declaration.json (k=4 regimes, E3c dispersion-rule tolerances, size-dependent KS guardrail, M=400, seed 0; declaration provenance and post-hoc labels included there)
disclosures: KS looseness: at N = 140 the two-sample KS critical distances are loose — 0.19 to 0.49 across the swept subset sizes (8 to 80). The KS guardrail therefore constrains little at this population size; the binding constraints in this audit are the dispersion-matched mean tolerances (tau_PSNR 0.2014 dB, tau_SSIM 0.00939, tau_LPIPS 0.00543). State this plainly whenever the DL3DV result is quoted.
Single method: nerfacto only. A second method (splatfacto/3DGS) is queued for the camera-ready; no discussion-period claim depends on it.

Self-generated logs: DL3DV publishes no per-scene metric logs (verified twice; benchmark-meta.csv is labels only), so the per-scene logs were generated by us during the discussion period; every log JSON carries a provenance field.

Dataset choice postdates submission: the audit contract was declared before any audit result was computed (see the declaration package), but DL3DV as a transfer target was selected during the discussion period.
3DGS queued for camera-ready: the two-method DL3DV joint event will be reported as camera-ready material, clearly separated from discussion-period results.
erratum: Effective Nutrition5k audit population is 3,521 scenes: one descriptor scene has no entry in the Zip-NeRF log (documented off-by-one vs the stated 3,522); the paper's own exports already use the 3,521-scene population.

headline_results.balanced_equal: never reaches the 0.08 Wilson-LCB target (best 42/400, LCB 0.0786 at 48 scenes); declines beyond 48 — the equal-allocation bias on a population whose largest regime holds 42% of scenes
headline_results.proportional_post_hoc_label: reaches 0.08 at 32 scenes (62/400, LCB 0.1228) and 0.20 at 40 scenes (LCB 0.2312); dominates uniform at every size

artifacts.logs: 140 per-scene metric JSONs + descriptor CSV (our own outputs; DL3DV images/inputs are NOT redistributed)
